risks.description: Equivalent or overlapping endpoints can elicit multiple tool calls on complex chemistry requests at 120-tool scale.
risks.evidence: A004 has one stable three-repeat multi-call unit; A002/A003 has two stable and four variable units, all localized to complex requests.
risks.treatment: Retain as intention-to-treat failure; do not post-hoc choose one call; disclose and test on independent data.

risks.description: The full five-target formal 0/4/8 controlled-neighbor matrix is not yet evidenced as complete.
risks.evidence: A003 has the complete controlled slice; other targets provide mixed and partial hard-case slices.
risks.treatment: Complete a no-leakage pool-coverage audit before CF-05 can be marked passed.

risks.description: Several development slices show ceiling performance and cannot discriminate routing methods.
risks.evidence: A003 and four-target mixed-realistic slices both achieved 100% across methods.
risks.treatment: Do not tune further on these tasks; use frozen independent validation for method comparison.

risks.description: Only five tools are verified executable while the remaining catalog entries primarily provide frozen Schema-level routing distractors.
risks.evidence: Current v1.1 catalog governance distinguishes verified executables from Schema-only entries.
risks.treatment: Limit claims to routing-scale evidence and verified-core execution; do not call all 120 entries validated engines.
